readout_signoffs_verdict_check.name: readout_signoffs_verdict_check
readout_signoffs_verdict_check.value: ("readout_signoffs"."kind" = 'sponsor' and "readout_signoffs"."verdict" in ('Go to production', 'Extend the pilot', 'Stop')) or ("readout_signoffs"."kind" <> 'sponsor' and "readout_signoffs"."verdict" in ('Satisfied', 'Satisfied with concerns', 'Not satisfied'))

recommendations_why_check.name: recommendations_why_check
recommendations_why_check.value: "recommendations"."why" is null or "recommendations"."why" in ('exception', 'sensitive', 'alternative', 'sent back', 'stepped in')

recommendations_outcome_check.name: recommendations_outcome_check
recommendations_outcome_check.value: "recommendations"."outcome" is null or "recommendations"."outcome" in ('Sent', 'Replied', 'Meeting booked', 'No response')
